Overflow-Clip

Line Length

This paragraph contains a very long run of continuous body text that is deliberately wide enough at this font size to wrap across several lines while keeping well over ninety characters visible on each individual rendered line so the line-length heuristic has something real to measure against its threshold and fire a finding for readability review.

Short lines are fine. No issue here at all.

Line Height

This paragraph has a tight line height across several wrapped lines, which can make separate lines of text feel visually cramped together and harder to scan when reading continuously.

This paragraph has a comfortable line height across several wrapped lines, which keeps each line visually distinct and easy to scan when reading continuously from start to finish.

All Caps

this is a long run of body text that is rendered in all capital letters via a css text transform which can reduce readability for continuous reading of ordinary paragraph content

This is ordinary mixed-case body text with no issue at all.
